notes_for_editor: Three list-type sources only: a compiled tower list, a USGS-derived map database entry, and a county index with headings and no detail. No history, staffing, fire or site description was found, and the status and access in the record are unverified. Searches for Hancock County tower history returned nothing usable. Unused lead: a Facebook video post titled 'Beaver fire lookout tower' (facebook.com/bousleyproductions) describes a visit to a tower seen from a lake; it gives no location and may or may not be this tower. Suggest Georgia Forestry Commission history staff, Hancock County local history sources, and the Georgia Archives.
